extDescription.message: Watch Netflix, Prime Video, Hulu, Disney+, Max, YouTube, and more in sync with someone far away, plus chat, notes, and reactions.

roomHint.message: Chat and notes are ready anytime. Start watching together to sync playback on Netflix, Prime Video, Hulu, Disney+, Max, Crunchyroll, or YouTube.

welcomeStep1.message: Add your name below, so they know it's you.

welcomeStep2.message: Send your invite link, just once. You'll share this room from then on.

welcomeStep3.message: Open a show and click 👥 Watch together. They get an invite on their screen, click Join, and you're in sync.

welcomeAside.message: While you watch, 💬 chat and 🙂 reactions sit on the right side of the video, halfway down. Got an invite link from someone? Click it again now that Tether's installed.

sessionHintOff.message: Your partner gets an invite on their screen. Ends on its own after 30 minutes without a video.

sessionHintOn.message: Playback is synced in your streaming tabs. Ends on its own after 30 minutes without a video.

sessionHintJoin.message: Join to sync your playback with theirs.

codeInvalid.message: That code doesn't look right. Room codes have 6 to 8 letters and numbers.

dbError.message: Couldn't reach that database. Check the URL and that it's a Realtime Database (not Firestore).

inviteHint.message: One click brings them to the exact show and moment while you're watching together.

peerSomeone.message: Someone else is in this room

peerOtherDevice.message: Also open on your other device

leaveConfirm.message: Leave this room and start a new one? Whoever you're watching with will need your new code.

notesPlaceholder.message: What to watch next, plans, or anything worth remembering together.

clearConfirm.message: Delete all chat messages and notes in this room? They'll be gone for both of you, and this can't be undone.

tipStart.message: Watching with someone? Click Watch together to sync this with them. They get an invite on their screen.

tipSession.message: You're watching together. 💬 chat and 🙂 reactions are here, and you can end the session from the chat.

statusIdle.message: Ready. Open a title to sync

statusNoRoom.message: Open Tether to join a room

startedShare.message: Watching together. Share your invite link from the Tether popup

chatEmpty.message: Say hi. Messages show up here and in the Tether popup.

endSessionTitle.message: Stop watching together. Chat stays in the Tether popup.

joinConnecting.message: Getting you to the right spot.

joinInvalid.message: It's missing a room code. Ask whoever sent it for a fresh invite link.

joinWaiting.message: Waiting for the other person to start watching...

joinStillWaiting.message: Still waiting. You're already in the room, so feel free to open your streaming service yourself whenever you're ready.

joinGaveUp.message: Refresh this page once they've started watching together, or just open the service yourselves. You're already in the room.

joinFailed.message: Refresh this page, or just open the service yourselves. You're already in the room.
